gaps.sentence: The store decided to branch ___ into online sales.
gaps.explanation: branch out = start doing something new and different.

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your toys when you've finished playing.
gaps.explanation: put away = put something in its usual place.

gaps.sentence: The subject cropped ___ again at dinner.
gaps.explanation: crop up = appear or happen unexpectedly.

gaps.sentence: They live ___ their pension and a small rent.
gaps.explanation: live off = have as income/food; live on = have as income (money).

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
He puts his success down ___ hard work and a bit of luck.
gaps.explanation: put something down TO something = believe it has that cause.

gaps.sentence: Can I ___ on these boots before buying them?
gaps.explanation: try on = put on clothes/shoes to check the fit.

gaps.sentence: They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.
